slides.title: Matplotlib Upgrade 💅
slides.content:
# Why Seaborn?

Built on top of Matplotlib, but provides:
1. **Better defaults**: Plots look modern instantly.
2. **Statistical functions**: Auto-calculates regressions, confidence intervals.
3. **Pandas integration**: Works directly with DataFrames.

```python
import seaborn as sns
sns.set_theme() # Apply pretty defaults
```

slides.title: Key Plots
slides.content:
# Powerful Visuals 📊

## Relational
```python
# Scatter with hue (color by category)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='total_bill', y='tip', hue='sex')
```

## Distribution
```python
# Histogram + Kernel Density Estimate (smooth curve)
sns.displot(data=df, x='age', kde=True)
```

## Categorical
```python
# Box Plot (shows median & quartiles)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='day', y='total_bill')
```

slides.title: Pair Plot
slides.content:
# The Summary Plot 🕵️

`pairplot` creates a grid of plots comparing EVERY numerical variable against EVERY other variable.

```python
sns.pairplot(df, hue='species')
```

> 💡 **Tip**: This is the first thing Data Scientists do to explore a new dataset!
